task.instruction: Find a popular JavaScript repository created in the last 30 days on GitHub with a Readme file.

final_answer:
I recommend **wheresryan22/anatomy** (https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy).

- **Why it fits:** It came up as the top result when I searched for JavaScript repositories created after 2026-10-01 (the last 30 days), sorted by stars. I didn't open the repository's page to check its creation date directly. It has about 23.2k stars and 1.9k forks.
- **What it is:** An agent skill, mainly for Claude, that builds detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. It produces SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
- **README:** It has a full README.md. The README covers a quick start (`npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g`), a gallery, install and usage instructions, examples, how it works, and limits. The repository also includes a LICENSE (MIT), CONTRIBUTING.md, and a CHANGELOG.
- **Activity:** It has 153 commits, 13 branches, 15 open issues, and 55 open pull requests. The latest commit is "Printable sheets: A4 and Letter PDFs from any figure (#126)".

Other popular new JavaScript repositories in the same results include HeyPuter/everything (6.1k stars) and alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion (5.8k stars).

judge.rationale: GitHub search was filtered to JavaScript repos created after 2026-10-01 and sorted by stars; the chosen repo shows 23.2k stars and README.md.
